reports.title: Third quarter of 2026 vs. Third quarter of 2025

lines: The Company remains on track to meet its annual attributable capital expenditures2 guidance of $1,500 million (+/- 5%) for 2026.

Assumptions used to update the Company’s cost guidance include a gold price of $4,350 per ounce, an oil price of $100 per barrel, and foreign exchange rates of 5.10 Brazilian reais, 920 Chilean pesos, and 40 Mauritanian ouguiyas to the U.S. dollar for the remainder of 2026.
